sloka: मनुजेन्द्रार्तरूपेण यदुक्तं च हनूमता।तदयुक्तमहं मन्ये सागरस्येव शोषणम् ।। ६.८४.९ ।।
transliteration: manujendrārtarūpeṇa yaduktaṁ ca hanūmatā।tadayuktamahaṁ manye sāgarasyeva śoṣaṇam ।। 6.84.9 ।।

translations.english: "I think that what has been spoken by Hanuman as truth (that Sita has been killed) is like drying up an ocean."
